title: Sri Lanka repatriates 40 Iranian sailors after providing medical care
description:
Sri Lanka repatriated 40 Iranian sailors after rescuing them from a distressed vessel off its southern coast and providing them with medical care.
"They departed by air early on Saturday," a foreign ministry spokesman told reporters here on Sunday.
The Embassy of Iran had funded the logistical arrangements for the departure, he said.
All 40 sailors received medical attention before returning to Iran, the spokesman said.
Sri Lankan authorities launched a humanitarian operation after receiving information about a merchant vessel in distress about 24 nautical miles off Galle, a port city on the island nation's southern coast.
The repatriation comes amid heightened scrutiny of Iranian vessels operating in waters around Sri Lanka following a series of maritime incidents involving Iranian naval ships and concerns over US sanctions on vessels linked to Iran.
In March, Iranian naval vessel IRIS Dena was sunk by a US submarine outside Sri Lankan waters, killing at least 84 Iranian sailors
